pattern: union two differently-headered tables, pivot, compute a difference, rank
question: rank centres by how much their turnout percentage dropped between the two years, worst first
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1

When the user asks to compare years or groups without asking for a change, keep those year/group columns and requested measures in the output.

Quote column names with double quotes when they contain spaces or odd characters. When two tables describe the same thing with different column names, UNION ALL them with aligned aliases.

CURRENT QUESTION:
rank centres by how much their turnout percentage dropped between the two years, worst first
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH attendance_combined AS (
  SELECT
    "Centre" AS centre,
    "Month" AS month,
    "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled,
    "Avg Daily Present" AS present,
    2023 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2023"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "centre_name" AS centre,
    "month" AS month,
    "enrolment" AS enrolled,
    "average_attendance" AS present,
    2024 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2024"
),
yearly_rates AS (
  SELECT
    centre,
    year,
    CAST(present AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(enrolled, 0) * 100 AS turnout_pct
  FROM attendance_combined
),
year_comparisons AS (
  SELECT
    t23.centre,
    t23.turnout_pct AS pct_2023,
    t24.turnout_pct AS pct_2024,
    (t24.turnout_pct - t23.turnout_pct) AS pct_point_change
  FROM yearly_rates t23
  JOIN yearly_rates t24 ON t23.centre = t24.centre
  WHERE t23.year = 2023 AND t24.year = 2024
)
SELECT
  centre,
  pct_point_change
FROM year_comparisons
ORDER BY pct_point_change ASC;
```
